Title: Relates to health insurance and provider divestment
Summary: Provides that it is unlawful for any person to directly or indirectly own, operate, or control the whole or any part of a health insurance company and a health care provider; requires divestment within three years; prohibits health insurance companies and health care providers found in violation of such provisions from receiving payment from certain state programs.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general obligations law, in relation to health insurance and provider divestment
